name: @haksanlulz/mcp-courtwatch
description: MCP server over CourtListener (Free Law Project) for free U.S. legal research: case-law and docket search, a free citator check (who cites this case), tables of authorities, RECAP docket filing histories, oral-argument audio, judges, and citation verification that catches fabricated cites. Built for legal aid, tenant defense, pro-se litigants, and public-interest lawyers.
author: Abishai James

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
